transcript:
Speaker A (Woman): पति की ऑफिस पार्टी में HR ने पूछा: 'So what do you do?' मैंने बोला: 'I... home... काम...' HR मुस्कुराई और किसी और से बात करने लग गई। पति पास में खड़ा था। घर तक गाड़ी में कोई नहीं बोला। वो साइलेंस जिंदगी की सबसे भारी इंसल्ट थी। [At my husband's office party, the HR asked: 'So what do you do?' I said: 'I... home... work...' The HR smiled and started talking to someone else. My husband was standing nearby. No one spoke in the car on the way home. That silence was the biggest insult of my life.]
Speaker B (HR): Hi, you must be Rahul's wife. So nice to finally meet you. What do you do?
Speaker A (Woman): I... home... काम... घर में। [I... home... work... at home.]
Speaker B (HR): Oh, that's nice.
Speaker A (Woman): HR मुस्कुराई और दूसरे कपल से बात करने लग गई। बॉस की वाइफ आती है। [The HR smiled and started talking to another couple. The boss's wife comes over.]
Speaker C (Boss's Wife): Hi dear, where are you from?
Speaker A (Woman): मैं जयपुर से। [I am from Jaipur.]
Speaker C (Boss's Wife): Oh lovely, Jaipur is beautiful. Do you work or...
Speaker A (Woman): मेरा चुप। पति आता है। [I was silent. My husband comes.]
Speaker D (Husband): Sorry, she is a bit tired today.
Speaker A (Woman): घर जाते वक्त गाड़ी में साइलेंस। [Silence in the car on the way home.]
Speaker D (Husband): आज अच्छा था पार्टी में? [Was it good at the party today?]
Speaker A (Woman): हाँ। [Yes.]
Speaker A (Woman): कोई और बात नहीं, दोनों चुप। उस रात सब सो गए, मैं बाथरूम में बैठ के रोई। सुंदर हूँ सब कहते हैं, पर सुंदर होने से क्या होता है जब मुंह से एक वर्ड नहीं निकले। शादी की क्योंकि प्रीटी थी, पर पार्टी में प्रीटी से काम नहीं चलता, इंग्लिश चाहिए। उस रात फोन उठाया, 'English Seekho' ऐप डाउनलोड किया। ₹1 का ट्रायल था। जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोला, 'Hello' से बात शुरू करें। 1 लाख से ज्यादा लोग देख चुके थे, प्ले किया। इतना सिंपल था कि मुझे लगा हाँ, ये मैं कर सकती हूँ। रोज रात को पति सो जाता, मैं फोन पे सीखती। अपने बारे में बताओ: 'My name is Meera, I am from Jaipur, I am a homemaker.' नाम और सिटी कॉन्फिडेंटली बोलें। अपना नाम और सिटी इंग्लिश में कॉन्फिडेंटली बोलना। अपनी फैमिली इंट्रोड्यूस करें: 'My husband works at Infosys, we have been married for one year.' AI कोच से प्रैक्टिस करती थी: 'Hi, nice to meet you, I am Meera, I am from Jaipur, I manage our home, I love cooking and reading.' गलत बोलती, सुधार देती। 500 बार गलत बोला, 500 बार सुधारा। कभी नहीं बोली होममेकर है, तुझे इंग्लिश की क्या जरूरत। 3 महीने बाद दिवाली पार्टी थी ऑफिस की। पति ने बोला: 'चलना है?' मैंने波ला: 'हाँ।' [No other words, both silent. That night everyone slept, I sat in the bathroom and cried. Everyone says I am beautiful, but what is the use of being beautiful when not a single word comes out of your mouth. He married me because I was pretty, but being pretty doesn't work at parties, you need English. That night I picked up my phone, downloaded the 'English Seekho' app. There was a ₹1 trial. Opened the General English show, start talking with 'Hello'. More than 1 lakh people had watched it, I played it. It was so simple that I felt yes, I can do this. Every night when my husband slept, I learned on my phone. Tell about yourself: 'My name is Meera, I am from Jaipur, I am a homemaker.' Speak your name and city confidently. Speak your name and city confidently in English. Introduce your family: 'My husband works at Infosys, we have been married for one year.' I practiced with the AI coach: 'Hi, nice to meet you, I am Meera, I am from Jaipur, I manage our home, I love cooking and reading.' If I spoke incorrectly, it corrected me. I spoke wrong 500 times, it corrected me 500 times. I never said I am a homemaker, why do you need English. 3 months later was the office Diwali party. My husband asked: 'Do you want to go?' I said: 'Yes.']
Speaker C (Boss's Wife): Meera, so good to see you again. How have you been?
Speaker A (Woman): I've been great, thank you. We recently went to Udaipur for our anniversary. The Lake Palace was absolutely beautiful. Have you been there?
Speaker C (Boss's Wife): Oh wow, no I haven't. You have to tell me more.
Speaker A (Woman): पति दूर से देख रहा था। बॉस आया, बोला: [My husband was watching from afar. The boss came and said:]
Speaker F (Boss): Rahul, your wife is very charming.
Speaker A (Woman): घर जाते वक्त गाड़ी में पति ने हाथ पकड़ा, बोला: [On the way home in the car, my husband held my hand and said:]
Speaker D (Husband): आज मुझे प्राउड फील हुआ। [Today I felt proud.]
Speaker A (Woman): मैंने बोला: 'English Seekho' ऐप डाउनलोड करो, जनरल इंग्लिश शो खोलो, AI कोच से प्रैक्टिस करो, ₹1 का ट्रायल है। अगली पार्टी में चुप मत बैठना, बोलो कॉन्फिडेंटली। पति का चेहरा देखना तब। [I said: Download the 'English Seekho' app, open the General English show, practice with the AI coach, there is a ₹1 trial. Don't sit silently at the next party, speak confidently. See your husband's face then.]
Speaker E (Male Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
summary: An AI-animated homemaker shares her journey of overcoming social embarrassment at her husband's office party due to her poor English. By practicing daily with the English Seekho app's AI coach, she confidently converses at the next gathering, making her husband proud. The ad promotes a 1-rupee trial of the app.
